html:
jewelry lead generation services

CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers looking for gold sellers, appraisal requests, or engagement ring shoppers. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

What you get

First 3 leads free; $40 per accepted lead thereafter; optional Pro website widget at $12/month

Why CaratBase

We start in Atlanta and plan to expand to other metro areas.

FAQ

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

Can I cancel the Pro widget? Yes. The Pro widget can be cancelled whenever, and it drops back to the free version.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
